def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

from lib import upscale

G=load()
D_in=G['Demo pair 1 input']; D_out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
T=G['Test input']

def frontiers(g):
    fr=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=0]
    fc=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if len({row[j] for row in g})==1 and row[0][j]!=0]
    return fr,fc

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    frs,fcs=frontiers(g)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    colors={v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0,)} - set(g[i][0] for i in frs)
    for c in colors:
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c]
        best=None
        for fr in frs:
            for fc in fcs:
                cs=set(cells)
                s=sum(1 for (i,j) in cs if (2*fr-i,j) in cs)+sum(1 for (i,j) in cs if (i,2*fc-j) in cs)
                if best is None or s>best[0]: best=(s,fr,fc)
        s,fr,fc=best
        if s==0: continue
        prevr=max([r for r in frs if r<fr]+[-1]); nextr=min([r for r in frs if r>fr]+[H])
        prevc=max([x for x in fcs if x<fc]+[-1]); nextc=min([x for x in fcs if x>fc]+[W])
        S={(i,j) for (i,j) in cells if prevr<i<nextr and prevc<j<nextc}
        changed=True
        while changed:
            changed=False
            for (i,j) in list(S):
                for (ni,nj) in ((2*fr-i,j),(i,2*fc-j)):
                    if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W and (ni,nj) not in S and not(ni in frs or nj in fcs):
                        S.add((ni,nj)); changed=True
        for (i,j) in S: out[i][j]=c
    return out

r=solve(D_in)
print(r==D_out)
print(solve(T))
